acceptance: Red test first: an item that gets a console claim or a console route between two reads returns superseded with the claim; at enforce the cycle runs no more phases.
An item that is not touched returns none.
The check reads the inbox state when it is asked and does not poll.
workflow.supersede.stage is a strict stage key (off, shadow, enforce; default shadow).
fix: Add a pure package supersede that reads the inbox state of a claimed item through the read API of the inbox mover and returns none or superseded with the console claim. The orchestrator asks it at each phase boundary only.
